_finding: x402 catalogues such as x402scan register x402 v2 only (22.11: its check rejects 'x402 v1 response detected'). The site now offers v2 beside v1: the offer in PAYMENT-REQUIRED on every 402, a payment in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE answered in PAYMENT-RESPONSE, and /api/pass, a route that is always the 402 without a pass. A module that speaks v1 only must leave every answer as it was.

mutations.name: a v2 payment is not read
mutations.expect: FAIL paid in v2 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE): 200, what the pass is, and the receipt in PAYMENT-RESPONSE only

mutations.name: a v2 payment is answered with the v1 receipt
mutations.expect: FAIL paid in v2 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE): 200, what the pass is, and the receipt in PAYMENT-RESPONSE only

mutations.name: the 402 carries no v2 offer header
mutations.expect: FAIL past the free minute on any route: the v1 body its clients read, and the v2 offer in PAYMENT-REQUIRED beside it

mutations.name: /api/pass answers the v1 body
mutations.expect: FAIL /api/pass without a pass is the 402, in v2: the offer in the body and in PAYMENT-REQUIRED, the same object

mutations.name: /api/pass serves without a pass
mutations.find: if (await passGate(req, res, { cors, why: 'a pass is sold here'
mutations.replace: if (false && await passGate(req, res, { cors, why: 'a pass is sold here'
mutations.expect: FAIL /api/pass without a pass is the 402, in v2: the offer in the body and in PAYMENT-REQUIRED, the same object
